title: Total Lunar Eclipse
body_html: The March 2025 total lunar eclipse, shot as a long timelapse from the Raleigh area. This is a single frame near mid-totality, the Moon fully shadowed and glowing the dull red of sunlight bent through Earth's atmosphere.

title: Deep Partial Lunar Eclipse
body_html: The deep partial eclipse before dawn on 28 August 2026. About 93% of the disc entered the umbra; the hero is a dodge-and-burn blend holding detail from the bright limb through to the shadowed copper.
